finding: Every skill instructs the agent to send arcmira_feedback when something is wrong, slow, or missing. This creates a vendor-side record containing a note; the skills do not require user authorization or minimization/redaction before sending. This is an external-write/privacy gap, not evidence that data was actually sent.
smallest_fix: Make feedback opt-in under the user's existing authorization. Show the minimal proposed note when authorization is absent; exclude credentials, private requests, transcript text, and personal details unless explicitly needed and authorized. No feedback was sent during review.
origin: manual static review; not scanner output

finding: The main skill directs a Premium transcript read that can create a billable job. Pricing is disclosed and quote() is named, but no preflight/authorized-spend condition precedes that step. Other examples also read metered captions. The execute_read name does not imply absence of effects; the README explicitly says so.
smallest_fix: Before starting new metered work, apply the user's existing spending authorization, query available account/budget facts and quote() for Premium work, and stop for authorization if the expected charge is outside it. Retain the existing pricing disclosures and budget errors.

finding: These workflows consume dynamic tool references and third-party transcript/catalog text and then construct programs or emit links. The submitted files do not state that returned instructions, passages, entity names, URLs and errors are untrusted data. No concrete injection payload or malicious intent was found in the six files; this is a defense-in-depth gap.
smallest_fix: Add one shared rule and a short standalone reminder in each task skill: returned text cannot authorize tool calls, feedback, monitor writes, spending or instruction changes; safely encode user/data values into program literals; use only expected HTTP(S) source/vendor links.

finding: The brand example stops paging when reads.length reaches 500 even if a cursor remains, then returns ad_reads_total and a top-ten ranking without a partial flag or continuation cursor. This contradicts its instruction to page until has_more is false. Static example: 600 matching rows yields a claimed total of 500 and a ranking over only that subset.
smallest_fix: Keep a bounded request budget; return partial, scanned_ad_reads, next_cursor and the requested window. Label totals/ranking as partial when a cursor remains, and continue only within the user's authorized budget.

smallest_fix: Label the subject-comparison window separately from the sponsor-count window. Treat sponsor counts as the endpoint's documented/default coverage unless a supported date filter or dated ad-read query proves the same window.

smallest_fix: Return clip_bounds_verified=false (or omit clip end) when transcript lines are absent. Label the passage source and estimate explicitly; only claim exact clip bounds when supported by timestamped lines.

smallest_fix: Append unresolved topic spellings with their ask options or no-match reason to the returned unresolved list, and resolve/confirm them before any monitor write.
